title: At First
subtitle: 「起初／一開始／原先／乍看之下」，究竟是哪一種 at first？
description: 「起初／一開始／原先／乍看之下」，究竟是哪一種 at first？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義詞之一，表示某件事在一開始時的狀態或情況；比 at first 稍正式。
words.example: Initially, the team expected the project to take three months.
words.exampleZh: 起初，團隊預計這個項目需要三個月。

exercises.original: At first, the team thought the task would be simple.
exercises.zh: 起初，團隊以為這項任務會很簡單。
exercises.upgrade: initially · 最初；起初

options.explanation: finally = 表示最後，時間方向相反。
firstly = 通常用來列舉第一點，不適合描述初始想法。
initially = thought the task would be simple 描述最初判斷，initially 最直接。
at last = 表示終於，不合。
eventually = 表示經過一段時間後最終。
first of all = 偏論述順序，不是初始狀態。

exercises.original: At first, sales were lower than expected.
exercises.zh: 起初，銷售比預期低。
exercises.upgrade: initially · 最初；起初

options.explanation: originally = 如果是原本計劃或設計更適合，這裡是早期數據。
initially = 描述早期表現時，initially 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, she was reluctant to join the programme.
exercises.zh: 起初，她不太願意參加這個計劃。
exercises.upgrade: initially · 最初；起初

options.explanation: first of all = 不是列第一個理由。
eventually = 通常會描述後來結果。
initially = 最初態度或反應最自然可用 initially。

words.note: 非常自然的片語，常用於口語和寫作，表示某件事在最開始的情況；也可用來引出第一個理由。
words.example: To begin with, I found the software difficult to use.
words.exampleZh: 一開始，我覺得這個軟件很難使用。

exercises.original: At first, I didn't understand how the system worked.
exercises.zh: 一開始，我不明白這個系統如何運作。
exercises.upgrade: to begin with · 起初；一開始

options.explanation: firstly = 可列舉，但這裡是時間上的初始狀況。
to begin with = 口語回顧最初狀態時，to begin with 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, the plan seemed too expensive.
exercises.zh: 一開始，這個計劃看起來太昂貴。
exercises.upgrade: to begin with · 起初；一開始

options.explanation: first of all = 可能像在列原因，而不是時間狀態。
to begin with = 描述最初印象或判斷時，to begin with 可自然替換。

exercises.original: At first, they only offered the service to local customers.
exercises.zh: 一開始，他們只向本地顧客提供服務。
exercises.upgrade: to begin with · 起初；一開始

options.explanation: originally planned = 會加入『原本計劃』含義。
to begin with = 描述早期營運方式，to begin with 很自然。

words.note: 較直白，強調某段時間、過程或活動的起點；常可替代 at first，但更具時間位置感。
words.example: At the beginning, the instructions seemed confusing.
words.exampleZh: 一開始，這些說明看起來很令人困惑。

exercises.original: At first, the course moved quite slowly.
exercises.zh: 課程一開始進度相當慢。
exercises.upgrade: at the beginning · 在開始時；起初

options.explanation: at the beginning = 如果重點是課程剛開始的一段時間，at the beginning 很直接。

exercises.original: At first, the room was almost empty.
exercises.zh: 開始時，房間幾乎是空的。
exercises.upgrade: at the beginning · 在開始時；起初

options.explanation: originally = 可用但會偏向原始狀態；這裡更像活動開始時。
at the beginning = 描述某活動或時段開始時的情況，at the beginning 最自然。

exercises.original: At first, there were only five people in the group.
exercises.zh: 最開始時，小組只有五個人。
exercises.upgrade: at the beginning · 在開始時；起初

options.explanation: at the beginning = 若只是陳述最開始的人數，at the beginning 很合適。

words.note: 常用於敘事或回顧，表示某件事在最初階段的情況；比 at the beginning 稍帶故事感。
words.example: In the beginning, the business had only two employees.
words.exampleZh: 起初，這家公司只有兩名員工。

exercises.original: At first, the company worked from a small office.
exercises.zh: 起初，公司在一間小辦公室工作。
exercises.upgrade: in the beginning · 起初；最初

options.explanation: in the beginning = 回顧公司早期故事時，in the beginning 帶有自然敘事感。

exercises.original: At first, nobody knew whether the idea would succeed.
exercises.zh: 起初，沒有人知道這個想法會否成功。
exercises.upgrade: in the beginning · 起初；最初

options.explanation: in the beginning = 敘述事情早期的不確定狀態，in the beginning 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, the village had no electricity.
exercises.zh: 起初，這條村沒有電力。
exercises.upgrade: in the beginning · 起初；最初

options.explanation: originally = 也可，但會更突出原始狀態；此處敘事語氣更適合 in the beginning。
in the beginning = 回顧一個地方早期情況時，in the beginning 很自然。

words.note: 當 at first 強調原本的計劃、想法、設計或狀態，之後有所改變時最自然。
words.example: Originally, we planned to travel by train.
words.exampleZh: 原先，我們計劃乘火車旅行。

exercises.original: At first, we planned to stay for three days.
exercises.zh: 原先，我們計劃逗留三天。
exercises.upgrade: originally · 原先；最初

options.explanation: originally = planned 暗示後來計劃改變，originally 最精確。
initially only = 雖可，但 planned + 後來改變最適合 originally。

exercises.original: At first, the building was designed as a library.
exercises.zh: 這座建築原先被設計成圖書館。
exercises.upgrade: originally · 原先；最初

options.explanation: to begin with = 可用，但 design origin 更自然用 originally。
originally = 原始設計用途最自然用 originally。

exercises.original: At first, the event was scheduled for May.
exercises.zh: 活動原先安排在五月舉行。
exercises.upgrade: originally · 原先；最初

options.explanation: originally = 原先排定的時間後來可能有變，originally 最精確。

words.note: 較正式，常見於商務、研究、計劃和正式寫作，表示某件事剛開始時。
words.example: At the outset, both sides agreed on the main objectives.
words.exampleZh: 一開始，雙方都同意主要目標。

exercises.original: At first, the researchers agreed on a common method.
exercises.zh: 一開始，研究人員同意採用共同方法。
exercises.upgrade: at the outset · 一開始；起初

options.explanation: at the outset = 正式研究語境中，描述項目剛開始時可用 at the outset。

exercises.original: At first, both companies expected the merger to be straightforward.
exercises.zh: 一開始，兩間公司都預期合併會很順利。
exercises.upgrade: at the outset · 一開始；起初

options.explanation: at the outset = 商務正式語境中，at the outset 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, the project had a very limited budget.
exercises.zh: 項目一開始的預算非常有限。
exercises.upgrade: at the outset · 一開始；起初

options.explanation: originally planned = 原句不是在講計劃，而是早期實際狀態。
at the outset = 正式描述項目初期狀況時，at the outset 最合適。

words.note: 自然、直接，強調活動、過程或時期剛開始的階段；比 initially 更口語。
words.example: At the start, the new system caused some confusion.
words.exampleZh: 剛開始時，新系統造成了一些混亂。

exercises.original: At first, the new software caused some confusion.
exercises.zh: 剛開始時，新軟件造成了一些混亂。
exercises.upgrade: at the start · 在開始時；最初

options.explanation: at the start = 較口語地描述一個過程剛開始的情況，at the start 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, the road was quiet.
exercises.zh: 剛開始時，道路很安靜。
exercises.upgrade: at the start · 在開始時；最初

options.explanation: originally = 可用但較像原始狀態。
at the start = 描述一段旅程或活動一開始的情況，at the start 很直接。

exercises.original: At first, the class focused on basic vocabulary.
exercises.zh: 課程剛開始時主要集中在基本詞彙。
exercises.upgrade: at the start · 在開始時；最初

options.explanation: at the start = 課程初期內容最自然可用 at the start。

words.note: 當 at first 指一個持續過程的早期階段，而不是單一瞬間時很合適。
words.example: In the early stages, the project relied heavily on volunteers.
words.exampleZh: 在初期，這個項目非常依賴義工。

exercises.original: At first, the project depended heavily on volunteers.
exercises.zh: 在初期，這個項目非常依賴義工。
exercises.upgrade: in the early stages · 在初期；在早期階段

options.explanation: in the early stages = 這裡不是單一開始瞬間，而是整個項目的早期階段，in the early stages 更精確。
in the final stages = 相反。

exercises.original: At first, the disease may cause only mild symptoms.
exercises.zh: 在早期階段，這種疾病可能只引起輕微症狀。
exercises.upgrade: in the early stages · 在初期；在早期階段

options.explanation: in the early stages = 疾病發展早期是持續階段，最適合 in the early stages。
in the late stages = 相反。

exercises.original: At first, the company relied on a small number of customers.
exercises.zh: 公司在初期只依賴少量顧客。
exercises.upgrade: in the early stages · 在初期；在早期階段

options.explanation: originally = 可用，但 early stages 更突出發展期。
in the early stages = 公司創業初期是一段發展階段，in the early stages 很自然。

words.note: 只有當 at first 指第一印象或第一眼判斷時才適用；不是一般時間順序上的同義詞。
words.example: At first glance, the two designs looked almost identical.
words.exampleZh: 乍看之下，兩個設計幾乎完全一樣。

exercises.original: At first, the two phones look almost identical.
exercises.zh: 乍看之下，兩部手機幾乎一模一樣。
exercises.upgrade: at first glance · 乍看之下；第一眼看來

options.explanation: initially = 可表示起初，但沒有第一眼視覺判斷的精確意味。
at the outset = 太正式且不是視覺第一印象。
at first glance = look almost identical 表示第一眼觀察，最精確是 at first glance。

exercises.original: At first, the problem seems easy to solve.
exercises.zh: 乍看之下，這個問題似乎很容易解決。
exercises.upgrade: at first glance · 乍看之下；第一眼看來

options.explanation: to begin with = 偏時間起點，沒有『第一印象』意味。
originally = 不是原先設計或計劃。
at first glance = seems 表示初步印象，at first glance 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, the chart appears to show a steady rise.
exercises.zh: 乍看之下，圖表似乎顯示穩定上升。
exercises.upgrade: at first glance · 乍看之下；第一眼看來

options.explanation: at first glance = appears to show + chart 是第一眼判讀，at first glance 最精確。
at the start = 會變成圖表時間軸起點，意思不同。

words.note: 較正式，常見於行政、法律和正式說明，表示在最初步驟或第一階段。
words.example: In the first instance, complaints should be sent to the department manager.
words.exampleZh: 首先，投訴應提交給部門經理。

exercises.original: At first, customers should contact the support team.
exercises.zh: 首先，顧客應聯絡支援團隊。
exercises.upgrade: in the first instance · 首先；起初

options.explanation: eventually = 表示最終，不是第一步。
at first glance = 是第一印象，不是程序第一步。
in the first instance = 正式程序中表示第一步應做甚麼，in the first instance 很自然。

exercises.original: At first, complaints are reviewed by the department manager.
exercises.zh: 首先，投訴由部門經理審核。
exercises.upgrade: in the first instance · 首先；起初

options.explanation: in the first instance = 行政處理程序的第一階段可用 in the first instance。
initially = 可用，但正式行政程序更常用 in the first instance。

exercises.original: At first, applicants should submit the form online.
exercises.zh: 首先，申請人應在網上提交表格。
exercises.upgrade: in the first instance · 首先；起初

options.explanation: in the first instance = 正式指示中的第一步最適合 in the first instance。

falseSynonyms.zh: 首先不一定等於 at first first 常表示順序上的第一；at first 表示最初一段時間的情況，通常暗示後來有所改變。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON First means first in order; at first describes an initial state or period.

falseSynonyms.zh: 第一點不等於起初 firstly 用來列出論點或步驟；at first 通常描述時間上的最初狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Firstly introduces a first point; at first refers to the beginning of a situation.

falseSynonyms.zh: 終於與 at first 相反 at last 表示經過等待後終於發生；at first 表示事情剛開始時。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At first refers to the beginning; at last refers to the eventual outcome.

falseSynonyms.zh: 最後不等於起初 finally 表示最後階段或最後一點；和 at first 的時間方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Finally marks the end, while at first marks the beginning.

falseSynonyms.zh: originally 只在部分語境等同 at first originally 強調原先的計劃、設計或狀態；若只是描述早期感受，未必適合。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Originally often suggests an earlier plan or state that later changed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可指一個明確起點 at the beginning 常和 of + 名詞 搭配，強調具體起點；at first 更常描述一開始的狀態或反應。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON At the beginning points to a starting point; at first often describes an initial condition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 起初與最終不同 initially 表示最初；eventually 表示最終經過一段過程後。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Initially means at first; eventually means in the end.

falseSynonyms.zh: 起初與首先不同 first of all 用來列第一個論點或步驟；at first 用來描述最初情況。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON First of all organizes ideas; at first describes an initial stage.
